title: UK filings: OnlyFans parent Fenix paid late owner Leonid Radvinsky $709M in the months leading up to his death in March; FY 2025 revenue rose 10% YoY to $1.55B (Shona Ghosh/Bloomberg)
summary: Shona Ghosh / Bloomberg: UK filings: OnlyFans parent Fenix paid late owner Leonid Radvinsky $709M in the months leading up to his death in March; FY 2025 revenue rose 10% YoY to $1.55B — OnlyFans, the platform known for adult content, paid its billionaire owner $709 million in dividends over several months prior to his death in March.
